dietary.title: Dietary preferences
dietary.footnote: Your AI nutrition assistant uses these to tailor every suggestion. Allergies and restrictions are treated as hard limits.
dietary.customHint: These are shortcuts — type any value that fits you.
dietary.itemTooLong: Each entry must be at most {{max}} characters.
dietary.limitReached: You can add at most {{max}} entries.
dietary.duplicate: That entry is already in the list.

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.hint: What you enjoy eating — the assistant leans towards these.

dislikes.label: Dislikes
dislikes.hint: Dishes or ingredients you would rather not see.

allergies.label: Allergies
allergies.hint: Hard limits — these are never suggested.

restrictions.label: Restrictions
restrictions.hint: Dietary rules you follow, such as medical or ethical ones.

healthGoal.label: Health goal
healthGoal.hint: One line about what you are working towards.
